gpu.scope: Actual bead shaders, isolated glass-water fragment, and actual blob vertex stage with a trivial readback fragment. No fluid solver or full scene renderer.

changes: One bead per rain contact; progressive full-footprint rain sampling; analytic exposed-object contacts.
Glass tint and occupied-water extinction/scattering for condensation.
Separate foreground-water correction for late glass composition without double attenuation.
Half-diameter optical lobes when immersed in the bulk water field; camera-independent size, unchanged airborne drops and physical water mass.
limitations: Full beach integration was not visually rechecked. An earlier full-renderer fixture triggered a graphics-process failure and was removed. The graphics service recovered automatically; no restart was requested or performed.
The screenshot bubble was inferred to be an immersed reconstructed water lobe; that exact spontaneous occurrence was not reproduced.
The small optical transport passes approximate incident light with sky spherical harmonics and direct sunlight. They do not add local lamp scattering.
safety: Existing CPU constraint fallback is unchanged. The final fixture creates no graphics context until its button is clicked and contains no full scene programs.
